race.comment: RAMASIS (1) is a talented four-year-old who shouldered 60.5kgs into third place when fresh from a spell over 1050m at Morphettville last start. Improved nicely to salute second-up last prep off a similar first-up rating. Perfectly placed to make it three wins from just six starts. ANOTHERHOUSE (3) is back after a ten-week lay-off. Opened the last campaign with a very good second over 1250m at Morphettville Parks off a far longer break. Capable of testing this field. GARCON RENARD (7) returned from an eight-week let-up with a last-gasp win over 1000m here recently. Kept fresh since that success a month ago. Up in grade but is in the mix again. EMBELLISHER (9) has been out of the winner's list for a while. Gets in well after the claim so worth some thought.
